content.what_it_is: Python port of the rip_2d postprocessing script, plotting eta and depth+velocity vectors per snapshot. User input section (L2-L18) builds fdir from $HOME/FUNWAVE-TVD/simple_cases/rip_2D/work/output (L13-L14). Loads dep.out (L22-L23), gets n,m (L24), dx=1.0, dy=2.0 (L27-L28), coordinate vectors via np.arange (L31-L32), meshgrid (L35). Snapshot range from console input (L37-L38; legacy comment nstart=280 L40). Per snapshot (L44-L93): zero-padded fnum via '{0:0>5}'.format (L48), loads umean_, vmean_, eta_, mask_ (L51-L54), sets masked cells to NaN where mask<1 (L57-L60). Panel 1 (subplot 121): eta pcolor with jet colormap (L66), axis [0, m*dx/2, 0, n*dy] (L67), horizontal colorbar with MaxNLocator(nbins=5) ticks labeled eta (m) (L68-L73), axis labels (L74-L75). Panel 2 (subplot 122): contourf of -dep with 10 levels and horizontal colorbar 'depth (m)' (L80-L82), quiver of u,v subsampled every everyWhich=6 points (L84-L88), xlabel and same axis window (L89-L90). Saves rip_2d_2subplot_num_<num>.png at dpi=400 and shows the figure (L92-L93). Unlike the MATLAB siblings, no vorticity/curl panel is drawn despite the filename.

io.name: nstart, nend from console via input

verbatim_spans.text: everyWhich=6 # plot every nth arrow (scales with image)

unresolved: filename says eta_vor but no vorticity is computed or plotted (no curl equivalent in this port); only eta and depth+quiver panels exist
dep is NaN-masked in-place per snapshot (L58) and never reloaded, accumulating holes across frames like the MATLAB siblings
plt.show() inside the loop (L93) blocks until each figure window is closed in interactive backends; frames also stack because no clf is called after subplotting
from matplotlib.cm import jet (L10) fails on matplotlib >= 3.9 where cm.jet was removed from that namespace; version requirement unstated
